name: OpenAny
description: The open marketplace for agents: 3,200+ APIs and 168+ AI models, one key. Browse free; pay per call. Hosted Streamable HTTP at https://mcp.openany.si. Browsing, search, and pricing need no key. Only run_api requires Authorization: Bearer <OPENANY_API_KEY>. The registry remote transport does not inject Bearer headers; configure the key in the client if you will execute calls.
